Triage: `domain:spec` confirmed; **type `Bug`, `priority:p3`, `pm:queue`.**

**Fence independently re-verified.** Held by **#17477** — read 2026-09-10T19:30:55Z: **`closed`**, and the card's probe re-run on current `origin/main` gives `git grep -c 'COLUMN_CONSTRAINT_FLAT_KEYS' -- packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` = **5**, matching. ⇒ Dispatchable.

Carrier: `SelectOptionSchema` (**6** row properties) in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`.

⭐ **One schema, two ledger carriers** — `field:options` and `object:fields.options` both resolve to `SelectOptionSchema`. Titling it once should clear **both** entries. ⚠️ The card says verify that it does rather than assuming, and **delete both entries in the same change** — the ledger is shrink-only, so a paid debt left in it reds just as loudly as an unpaid one.

⭐ **Smallest of the three — take it first.** It exercises the whole loop (title, verify, delete ledger entries) at the lowest cost, which is the right way to learn a shrink-only ledger.

## The family, graded as one shape

All three are `Part of #17232` (`pm:dispatched`, p2) and share the mechanism that makes them measurable — `packages/spec/src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`, an **exact, shrink-only ledger**: a carrier absent from it must be fully titled (a new untitled repeater reds on arrival), and a carrier present in it must still be untitled (a paid debt must be **deleted** from the ledger).

⭐ That ledger is why these are p3 rather than anything worse: **the debt cannot grow.** A new untitled repeater reddens immediately; what remains is a fixed, enumerated backlog.

⇒ Each card is one carrier set = one slice = one changeset. ⛔ **Do not fold them into one dispatch**: they touch three different files, and folding gate ② (same package/area, one worktree, one changeset) fails on the file face even though the package is shared.

⚠️ Counts were derived **through the platform's own predicate** (`z.toJSONSchema` over `getMetadataTypeSchema`), ⛔ not by regexing source. Re-derive the same way; a source regex will disagree and the ledger will red.

`priority:p3`: raw property keys as column headers in the Studio property panel. Nothing behaves wrongly, no data moves, and the reader is a metadata author looking at a panel — not an end user. `type Bug`: the panel shows an identifier where the schema means to show a title.

Dark control: a nonexistent path reads 0. ⚠️ Radius: the first files page (100 entries) of each open PR; a PR with more than 100 changed files is under-read and an unopened branch is invisible by construction.

⚠️ **One reading the taker must not ignore:** `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` reads **HELD by #19147**. This card's fix should not need it — the card's own claim is that `field:options` and `object:fields.options` both resolve to the **same** `SelectOptionSchema` (`field.zod.ts:327`), so titling it once clears both carriers. ⇒ **verify that, ⛔ do not assume it.** If the second carrier turns out to need an edit in `object.zod.ts`, that is a breach of this claim's surface AND a live serial — stop and report rather than widening.

## Why this p3 is not a p3 the North Star bars

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 「优先级」 item 3 bars p2/p3 **工具卡、契约卫生卡** while product P0/P1 are open. This is neither. Studio's property panel renders a `type: 'repeater'` field as a table whose column headers read `items.properties[k].title ?? k`; with no `title` the fallback runs **in every locale, English included**, so the person building the app sees raw machine keys inside an otherwise translated panel. That is 「不写代码在运行中改应用」 — a capability the North Star's definition line names — degraded on its own authoring surface. Triage refused the i18n route by name; the titles are hard-coded English **by design**.

## The fence has dropped, and the serial with it

The card records its own unlock: the `field.zod.ts` fence was held by **#17477**, which landed. Independently, the file read FREE in this act's scan. ⇒ both the card's stated condition and this seat's live measurement agree.

## The mechanism, and the one thing that must not be done to it

`packages/spec/src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts` is an **exact, shrink-only ledger**: a carrier absent from it must be fully titled (a new untitled repeater reds on arrival), and a carrier present in it must still be untitled (a paid debt must be DELETED from the ledger). The work is therefore: title each row property, then remove this carrier's entries. ⛔ **Do not weaken the ledger to make it pass** — that would convert a ratchet into decoration, and this card exists because the ratchet works.

⇒ `Clause-②: no`: `.meta({ title })` is JSON-Schema presentation metadata and a ledger row is a test. Neither moves what any schema accepts. ⚠️ If the taker's measurement contradicts that, **stop and re-declare** rather than proceeding. The `domain:spec` lane still owes a contract review of record on this round (row C6), which this seat raises once the PR exists.
